themes.name: Voice chat toxicity
themes.summary: Players report frequent harassment, slurs, sexist comments, and screaming in voice chat. Some avoid voice chat entirely or mute everyone.

got called slurs in voice
As a woman I can't use voice chat in this game
hurling insults on voice
sexist comments on comms basically every other game
the mic toxicity is out of control

themes.name: Performance and stutters
themes.summary: Players report low frame rates, FPS drops, and stutters during matches, even with capable hardware or reduced settings. The stutter can lead to deaths.

comments.quote: drop to 40fps on Greywater when it rains
was 70 fps in the menu and 25 in the match
big stutter right as i respawn

themes.name: Bad spawns
themes.summary: Players report spawning or being dropped in front of enemies or in dangerous positions. This leads to immediate deaths and repeated frustration.

comments.quote: died 4 times before i took a single step
spawned right in front of their whole team and died in 2 seconds
spawning right in front of the enemy sniper
being dropped next to 3 enemies with full health while i have no abilities ready

themes.name: Tutorial and onboarding gaps
themes.summary: Players report that onboarding and tutorial lessons rush through mechanics or fail to explain cooldowns, charge, ult use, and overcharge. Players finish without understanding key systems.

comments.quote: assumes you already played hero shooters
rushes thru like 10 mechanics in 3 mins
tutorial mentions it once in a popup that disappears before you can read it
not charged and theres no explanation how to charge it

themes.name: Confusing menus and UI
